rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a planned vacation or road-trip schedule.

example.english: I've already planned the itinerary for our trip to Taiwan.

rows.note: Use this when you mean the route or proposed route rather than the activities schedule.

example.english: This itinerary takes us along the coast before we head into the mountains.

rows.note: Use this for a formal written account or record of a journey, not an ordinary travel schedule.

example.english: The archive preserved an itinerary recording the scholar's journey.
